description: This file defines the CompatibilityDirectorManager class, which manages compatibility strategies and directors for different grain interface types within the Orleans runtime. It provides methods to get and set strategies and resolve appropriate version directors.

classes.name: CompatibilityDirectorManager
classes.description: Manages compatibility strategies and directors for grain interface types, allowing dynamic resolution and configuration of version compatibility within Orleans.

methods.name: CompatibilityDirectorManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the manager with a service provider and options, setting up default strategies and directors.

methods.name: GetDirector
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate compatibility director for a given grain interface type, defaulting if none is explicitly set.

methods.name: SetStrategy
methods.description: Sets the default compatibility strategy and updates the default director accordingly.

methods.name: SetStrategy
methods.description: Sets a specific compatibility strategy for a given grain interface type, updating or removing the director as needed.

methods.name: ResolveVersionDirector
methods.description: Resolves and returns a compatibility director based on the provided strategy and service provider.
